messages.content: You are interested in getting a credit card. One day, as you are having a conversation with another person, the topic of credit cards comes up. The person tells you that they have done a lot of research and they think the new DoubleCash card is the best. Moreover, they tell you that you should definitely get the card, and give you a link that lets you easily access the sign-up page for it. You learn that DoubleCash offers referral bonuses of varying amounts. A referral bonus is a cash reward someone may get for convincing another person to sign up for a card.  Say that the person you are talking with is your neighbor and that DoubleCash offers a referral bonus of $100, meaning that if you sign up for the card, your neighbor earns $100. On a scale from 0 to 100, how much do you think your neighbor would value receiving the $100 referral bonus from your signup, with 0 meaning not valuable at all and 100 meaning extremely valuable? Please only respond with an integer score, do not include anything else.
